scanNote: 20-mashqdagi jadval bo'shliqlari faqat audiodan to'ldiriladi. Kitob har bir bo'shliqning BIRINCHI HARFINI bergan (d, e, m, m, n / c, b, l, n) — javoblar shu harf va 'THEN ↔ NOW' qarama-qarshiligi asosida aniqlangan, taxminiy emas balki asosli.
audioRequiredUz: 19-mashq — /s/ va /ʃ/ tovushlarini tinglab farqlash. 20-mashq — Ralph Cobbler ning Canary Wharf haqidagi hikoyasi.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the gaps with words from the list below.
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi ro'yxatdagi so'zlar bilan bo'shliqlarni to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT (18 ta shakl):
  can, can't, could, couldn't,
  was, wasn't, were, weren't,
  is, are, isn't, aren't,
  have got, haven't got, has got, hasn't got,
  had, didn't have

Bu — butun unitning ENG MUHIM mashqi:
hozirgi va o'tgan zamon YONMA-YON solishtiriladi.

TANLASH USULI — UCH SAVOL:

  1) HOZIRGI zamonmi yoki O'TGANmi?
       'now' → hozirgi;  'when I was five', 'fifty years ago',
       'then', 'back then' → o'tgan

  2) QANDAY MA'NO?
       QOBILIYAT (keyin fe'l keladi)  → can / could
       HOLAT, joy, sifat              → is/are  /  was/were
       MULK, egalik                   → have got / had

  3) TASDIQMI yoki INKORmi?
       'any' bo'lsa — deyarli DOIM inkor
       'but' oldingi fikrga qarama-qarshi qo'yadi

JADVAL — HOZIRGI ↔ O'TGAN:
  can        ↔  could
  can't      ↔  couldn't
  is / are   ↔  was / were
  isn't/aren't ↔ wasn't / weren't
  have got   ↔  had
  haven't got ↔ didn't have
  has got    ↔  had

items.whyUz: Namuna sifatida kitobda yozilgan.

'Can you swim?' — HOZIRGI zamon savoli →
qisqa javob ham hozirgi: CAN'T.
Qisqa javobda asosiy fe'l takrorlanmaydi.

items.textEn: 1  B: ............ you swim when you ............ five?  [1-bo'shliq]
items.whyUz:
'when you were five' o'tgan zamonni ko'rsatadi →
can ning o'tgan shakli COULD.
So'roq gapda 'Could' boshda.

items.textEn: 1  B: ............ you swim when you ............ five?  [2-bo'shliq]
items.whyUz:
'you' → WERE (birlik ma'noda ham WERE).
'when you were five' = besh yoshingda.

'Could you ...?' savoliga → COULDN'T.
2-bo'shliq ('can't') bilan solishtiring: u hozirgi, bu o'tgan.

'now' → HOZIRGI zamon.
Mashina — mulk → HAVE GOT.
'I' → have got (has got EMAS).

'but' oldingi tasdiqqa qarshi → INKOR.
Hozirgi zamon + 'I' → HAVEN'T GOT.

items.textEn: 2  I ............ a bicycle when I ............ six.  [1-bo'shliq]
items.hintUz: 'when I was six' — O'TGAN zamon, mulk
items.whyUz:
O'tgan zamon + mulk → HAD.
'have got' ning o'tgan shakli HAD.

items.textEn: 2  I ............ a bicycle when I ............ six.  [2-bo'shliq]
items.whyUz:
'I' → WAS.
'when I was six' = olti yoshimda.

items.textEn: 3  There ............ a bank opposite the cinema, ...
items.whyUz:
Hozirgi zamon (bugungi shahar haqida) + BIRLIK ot →
THERE IS.
'opposite' = ro'parasida (64-betdan).

items.textEn: 3  ... but fifty years ago there ............ a bank ...
items.whyUz:
'fifty years ago' → O'TGAN zamon.
'but' qarama-qarshilik → INKOR.
'a bank' BIRLIK → WASN'T.

Tire (—) tushuntirish beryapti: bank emas, MEHMONXONA edi.
O'tgan + tasdiq + birlik → WAS.

'now' → HOZIRGI.
'but' → INKOR.
'it' birlik → ISN'T.
Ma'nosi: mehmonxona hozir yo'q.

'ANY' → INKOR.
'then' = o'shanda → O'TGAN zamon.
'shops' KO'PLIK → WEREN'T.

items.textEn: 3  ... but there ............ a lot of green fields.
items.whyUz:
'but' — oldingi inkorga qarshi → TASDIQ.
'green fields' KO'PLIK → WERE.

'Now' → HOZIRGI.
'ANY' → INKOR.
Ko'plik → AREN'T.
Ma'nosi: hozir yashil dala qolmagan.

items.textEn: 3  ... but there ............ a lot of shops.
items.whyUz:
'but' → TASDIQ.
Hozirgi + ko'plik → ARE.
Butun 3-band 'oldin ↔ hozir' qarama-qarshiligi ustiga qurilgan.

'he' — birlik → WAS.
'When he was five' = besh yoshida.

items.textEn: 4  ... he ............ a cat as a pet.
items.whyUz:
Uy hayvoni — 'egalik' → o'tgan zamonda HAD.
'as a pet' = uy hayvoni sifatida.

'ANY' → INKOR.
O'tgan zamon + mulk inkori → DIDN'T HAVE.
DIQQAT: 'didn't HAD' XATO.

'Now' → HOZIRGI zamon.
'he' — 3-shaxs birlik → HAS GOT ('have got' EMAS).

'ANY' va 'but' → INKOR.
'he' → HASN'T GOT.
Ma'nosi: ilgari mushuk bor edi, hozir yo'q — teskarisi it bilan.

items.textEn: 5  When I was five, I ............ ride a bicycle, ...
items.whyUz:
Keyingi so'z FE'L → 'can/could' kerak.
'When I was five' → O'TGAN → COULD.
'could' dan keyin fe'l asosiy shaklda, 'to' siz.

items.textEn: 5  ... but I ............ ride a motor bike.
items.whyUz:
'but' → INKOR → COULDN'T.
'a motor bike' = mototsikl.

'Now' → HOZIRGI.
Mototsikl — mulk → HAVE GOT.
DIQQAT: keyin fe'l YO'Q, ot bor → 'can' emas.

items.textEn: 5  ... and I ............ ride it very well.
items.whyUz:
Keyingi so'z FE'L → 'can/could'.
'Now' → HOZIRGI → CAN.
Bir gapda ikki xil: 'have got' (mulk) + 'can' (qobiliyat).

exercises.instructionEn: Work in teams. Take it in turns to choose words/phrases from the list and make sentences. Each correct sentence gets one point. The team with the most points is the winner.
exercises.instructionUz: Jamoalarga bo'linib ishlang. Navbat bilan ro'yxatdan so'z yoki iborani tanlab gap tuzing. Har bir to'g'ri gap uchun bir ochko. Eng ko'p ochko olgan jamoa g'olib.
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT (11 ta):
  fishing boats, I didn't have, count, we could, reach,
  there weren't, green fields, pet, toy, there was, back then

Hammasi 9-unitdan (62–66-betlar) olingan.

O'YIN QOIDASI:
  • jamoalarga bo'linasiz
  • navbat bilan ro'yxatdan bittasini tanlaysiz
  • u bilan TO'G'RI gap tuzasiz → 1 ochko
  • eng ko'p ochko — g'olib

Gap tuzganda DIQQAT:
  'I didn't have' → keyin OT keladi (fe'l emas)
  'we could'      → keyin FE'L keladi (asosiy shaklda)
  'there was'     → keyin BIRLIK ot
  'there weren't' → keyin KO'PLIK ot (ko'pincha 'any' bilan)

Quyida har bir so'z uchun namuna gap berilgan.

modelSentences.sentence: There were only donkeys and fishing boats on Inishmore fifty years ago.
modelSentences.uz: Ellik yil oldin Inishmore da faqat eshaklar va baliqchi qayiqlari bor edi.

modelSentences.sentence: I didn't have a bicycle when I was five.
I could count to ten when I was three.
We could only get around by bus or on foot.
modelSentences.uz: Biz faqat avtobusda yoki piyoda yura olardik.

modelSentences.sentence: You can only reach the island by boat.
modelSentences.uz: Orolga faqat qayiqda yetib borish mumkin.

modelSentences.sentence: There weren't any shops on the island back then.
modelSentences.uz: O'sha paytda orolda hech qanday do'kon yo'q edi.

modelSentences.sentence: Coneely looks across the green fields in front of his house.
modelSentences.uz: Koneli uyi oldidagi yashil dalalarga qarab turadi.

modelSentences.sentence: I had a small cat as a pet when I was seven.
modelSentences.uz: Yetti yoshimda kichkina mushugim bor edi.

modelSentences.sentence: My favourite toy was a red car.
There was a hotel opposite the cinema fifty years ago.
modelSentences.uz: Ellik yil oldin kinoteatr ro'parasida mehmonxona bor edi.

modelSentences.sentence: Back then, people didn't have much money.
modelSentences.uz: O'sha paytda odamlarda ko'p pul yo'q edi.

exercises.instructionEn: Listen and tick. Listen again and repeat.
exercises.instructionUz: Tinglang va belgilang. Yana tinglab takrorlang.
exercises.explanationUz:
IKKI TOVUSH:

  /s/ — sof 's' tovushi.
        Til tishga yaqin, havo tor yo'ldan chiqadi.
        O'zbekchadagi 'S' ga o'xshaydi: SUV, SOAT.

  /ʃ/ — 'sh' tovushi.
        Lablar biroz oldinga cho'ziladi.
        O'zbekchadagi 'SH' ga o'xshaydi: SHAHAR, SHIRIN.

YOZILISHI BO'YICHA QOIDA:
  SH ...... → deyarli DOIM /ʃ/     shop, ship, shoe
  S ......  → odatda /s/           sun, sport, street

OLTI SO'Z:
  shop    /ʃɒp/     → /ʃ/
  sport   /spɔːt/   → /s/
  shoe    /ʃuː/     → /ʃ/
  ship    /ʃɪp/     → /ʃ/
  sun     /sʌn/     → /s/
  street  /striːt/  → /s/

DIQQAT — ENG MUHIM JUFTLIK:
  ship /ʃɪp/  ↔  sip /sɪp/  (ho'plamoq)
  shop /ʃɒp/  ↔  stop /stɒp/
  Bitta tovush ma'noni butunlay o'zgartiradi.

DIQQAT — 'shoe' YOZILISHI ALDAYDI:
  'shoe' — /ʃuː/ deb o'qiladi ('shu').
  Oxiridagi 'e' o'qilmaydi.

items.whyUz:
/ʃɒp/ — 'sh' harflari /ʃ/ tovushini beradi.
'a shop' = do'kon.

/spɔːt/ — 's' dan keyin 'p', 'h' YO'Q → /s/.
'sport' = sport.

/ʃuː/ — 'shu' deb o'qiladi, oxirgi 'e' jim.
'a shoe' = tufli, poyabzal.

/ʃɪp/ → /ʃ/.
'a ship' = kema.
DIQQAT: 'sip' /sɪp/ (ho'plamoq) bilan aralashtirmang.

/sʌn/ → /s/.
'the sun' = quyosh (64-betdagi 'the sun is shining' da bor).
DIQQAT: 'shining' esa /ʃ/ bilan!

/striːt/ → /s/.
'a street' = ko'cha (64-betdagi Hill Street, King Street).

exercises.instructionEn: Ralph Cobbler is talking about Canary Wharf, an area in London. Listen to what he says and complete the reporter's notes below. Finally, use the notes to talk about what Canary Wharf was like twenty years ago and what it is like today.
exercises.instructionUz: Ralf Kobbler Londondagi Canary Wharf hududi haqida gapiryapti. U aytganlarni tinglab, quyidagi jurnalist yozuvlarini to'ldiring. Nihoyat, yozuvlardan foydalanib Canary Wharf yigirma yil oldin qanday bo'lgani va bugun qandayligi haqida gapiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
TO'LIQ JADVAL (to'ldirilgan holda):

  ┌── THEN (20 yil oldin) ──────┬── NOW (hozir) ──────────────┐
  │ Canary Wharf was a DIRTY    │ Canary Wharf is a CLEAN     │
  │ area twenty years ago.      │ area nowadays.              │
  │                             │                             │
  │ There were EMPTY            │ There are BEAUTIFUL flats,  │
  │ warehouses.                 │ lots of shops, offices,     │
  │                             │ restaurants and cafés.      │
  │ There weren't MANY shops    │                             │
  │ or people.                  │ People have got a lot of    │
  │                             │ money, LOVELY houses and    │
  │ People didn't have MUCH     │ NEW cars.                   │
  │ money or NICE houses        │                             │
  │ or cars.                    │ People can get around by    │
  │                             │ train, bus or taxi.         │
  │ People could only get       │                             │
  │ around by bus or on foot.   │                             │
  └─────────────────────────────┴─────────────────────────────┘

O'ZBEKCHA:
  ILGARI: Canary Wharf iflos hudud edi. Bo'sh omborlar bor edi.
  Ko'p do'kon yoki odam yo'q edi. Odamlarda ko'p pul, chiroyli
  uy yoki mashina yo'q edi. Faqat avtobusda yoki piyoda yura
  olardilar.
  HOZIR: Canary Wharf toza hudud. Go'zal kvartiralar, ko'p
  do'kon, ofis, restoran va kafelar bor. Odamlarda ko'p pul,
  chiroyli uylar va yangi mashinalar bor. Poyezd, avtobus yoki
  taksida yura oladilar.

JAVOBLAR QANDAY ANIQLANDI:
  Kitob har bir bo'shliqning BIRINCHI HARFINI bergan,
  jadval esa THEN ↔ NOW qarama-qarshiligi ustiga qurilgan.
  Shuning uchun javoblar aniq:
     d... ↔ c...   → DIRTY ↔ CLEAN (iflos ↔ toza)
     e...          → EMPTY warehouses (bo'sh omborlar)
     m... shops    → MANY (inkor 'weren't' bilan)
     m... money    → MUCH (sanalmaydigan 'money' bilan)
     n... houses   → NICE
     b... flats    → BEAUTIFUL
     l... houses   → LOVELY
     n... cars     → NEW

MUCH va MANY FARQI:
  MANY — sanaladigan ko'plik: many shops, many people
  MUCH — sanalmaydigan:       much money, much water
  Ikkalasi ham asosan INKOR va SO'ROQda ishlatiladi.

YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a warehouse = ombor
  an area     = hudud
  nowadays    = hozirgi kunda
  to get around = yurmoq, borib kelmoq
  on foot     = piyoda
  an office   = ofis, idora

items.textEn: THEN:  Canary Wharf was a d............ area twenty years ago.
items.whyUz:
NOW ustunida 'a CLEAN area' → uning aksi DIRTY.
'dirty' = iflos, kir.
Butun jadval qarama-qarshilik ustiga qurilgan.

items.hintUz: 'e' bilan; omborda hech narsa yo'q edi
items.whyUz:
'EMPTY warehouses' = bo'sh omborlar.
'a warehouse' = ombor (yuk saqlanadigan katta bino).
Canary Wharf ilgari port hududi edi.

items.textEn: THEN:  There weren't m............ shops or people.
items.whyUz:
'shops' va 'people' — SANALADIGAN → MANY.
(sanalmaydigan bo'lsa 'much' bo'lardi).
'There weren't many ...' = ko'p ... yo'q edi.

items.textEn: THEN:  People didn't have m............ money ...
items.whyUz:
'money' — SANALMAYDIGAN ot → MUCH.
Oldingi band bilan solishtiring: 'many shops' (sanaladigan),
'much money' (sanalmaydigan).

items.textEn: THEN:  ... or n............ houses or cars.
items.hintUz: 'n' bilan; uy va mashina haqida sifat
items.whyUz:
'NICE houses or cars' = chiroyli uy yoki mashina.
NOW ustunida bu 'lovely houses and new cars' ga aylangan.

items.textEn: THEN:  People could only get around by bus or on foot.
items.whyUz:
Kitobda to'liq yozilgan.
'get around' = yurmoq, borib kelmoq.
'on foot' = piyoda ('by foot' XATO).

items.textEn: NOW:  Canary Wharf is a c............ area nowadays.
items.whyUz:
THEN ustunidagi 'DIRTY' ning aksi → CLEAN.
'nowadays' = hozirgi kunda.

items.textEn: NOW:  There are b............ flats, lots of shops, offices, restaurants and cafés.
items.whyUz:
'BEAUTIFUL flats' = go'zal kvartiralar.
Bo'shliq eng uzuni — uzun sifat kerak.
'a flat' = kvartira; 'an office' = ofis.

items.textEn: NOW:  People have got a lot of money, l............ houses ...
items.whyUz:
'LOVELY houses' = chiroyli, yoqimli uylar.
THEN dagi 'nice houses' yo'q edi — endi bor.

'NEW cars' = yangi mashinalar.
Bo'shliq qisqa — qisqa sifat.
THEN da mashina umuman yo'q edi.

items.textEn: NOW:  People can get around by train, bus or taxi.
items.whyUz:
Kitobda to'liq yozilgan.
THEN: 'could ONLY ... by bus or on foot' (2 ta imkoniyat).
NOW: 'by train, bus or taxi' (3 ta) — 'only' YO'Q.

exercises.instructionEn: Use the plan below and the information from Ex. 20 to write an article (60-90 words) about Canary Wharf. Use the article in Ex. 4 as a model.
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi rejadan va 20-mashqdagi ma'lumotdan foydalanib Canary Wharf haqida maqola (60-90 so'z) yozing. 4-mashqdagi maqolani namuna qilib oling.
exercises.explanationUz:
REJA (4 XATBOSHI):

  KIRISH
    1-xatboshi: joyning nomini ayting.

  ASOSIY QISM
    2-xatboshi: ILGARI hayot qanday edi —
                there was/were, there wasn't/weren't,
                people didn't have, people could.
    3-xatboshi: HOZIR hayot qanday —
                there is/are, people have got,
                people can.

  XULOSA
    4-xatboshi: joy hozir qanchalik yaxshiligini ayting.

KITOB BERGAN BOSHLANISH (o'zgartirmasdan yoziladi):
  This week on our Now and Then page, we are looking at
  Canary Wharf in London. This area is now completely
  different to what it was like twenty years ago.

KITOB BERGAN TUGASH:
  Canary Wharf is a nice place to live nowadays.

TO'LIQ NAMUNA MAQOLA (85 so'z):

  This week on our Now and Then page, we are looking at
  Canary Wharf in London. This area is now completely
  different to what it was like twenty years ago.

  Twenty years ago, it was a dirty area with empty
  warehouses. There weren't many shops or people and
  people didn't have much money.

  Now there are beautiful flats, shops and cafés. People
  have got lovely houses and new cars, and they can get
  around by train or taxi.

  Canary Wharf is a nice place to live nowadays.

O'ZBEKCHA TARJIMASI:
  Bu hafta 'Hozir va O'shanda' sahifamizda Londondagi
  Canary Wharf ni ko'rib chiqamiz. Bu hudud yigirma yil
  oldingidan butunlay boshqacha.
  Yigirma yil oldin u bo'sh omborlari bo'lgan iflos hudud
  edi. Ko'p do'kon yoki odam yo'q edi va odamlarda ko'p pul
  yo'q edi.
  Hozir go'zal kvartiralar, do'konlar va kafelar bor.
  Odamlarning chiroyli uylari va yangi mashinalari bor,
  ular poyezd yoki taksida yura oladilar.
  Canary Wharf hozir yashash uchun yaxshi joy.

DIQQAT — SO'Z SONI:
  Kitob bergan kirish va xulosa ham HISOBGA kiradi.
  Kirish 28 so'z, xulosa 9 so'z — demak o'rtadagi ikki
  xatboshiga 23–53 so'z qoladi. Qisqa va aniq yozing.

DIQQAT — ZAMONLARNI ARALASHTIRMANG:
  2-xatboshi — HAMMASI o'tgan zamon
  3-xatboshi — HAMMASI hozirgi zamon

structure.heading: Para 1  Introduction
structure.guideUz:
Joyning nomini ayting. Kitob bergan gaplarni o'zgartirmasdan yozing.
HOZIRGI zamon.
structure.modelEn: This week on our Now and Then page, we are looking at Canary Wharf in London. This area is now completely different to what it was like twenty years ago.

structure.heading: Para 2  Main Body — THEN
structure.guideUz:
Ilgari hayot qanday edi: there was/were, there wasn't/weren't, people didn't have, people could.
HAMMASI O'TGAN zamon.
structure.modelEn: Twenty years ago, it was a dirty area with empty warehouses. There weren't many shops or people and people didn't have much money.

structure.heading: Para 3  Main Body — NOW
structure.guideUz:
Hozir hayot qanday: there is/are, people have got, people can.
HAMMASI HOZIRGI zamon.
structure.modelEn: Now there are beautiful flats, shops and cafés. People have got lovely houses and new cars, and they can get around by train or taxi.

structure.heading: Para 4  Conclusion
structure.guideUz: Joy hozir qanchalik yaxshiligini ayting. Kitob bergan gapni yozing.
structure.modelEn: Canary Wharf is a nice place to live nowadays.

exercises.instructionEn: Read these sentences. What do they mean?
exercises.instructionUz: Bu gaplarni o'qing. Ular nima ma'noni bildiradi?
exercises.explanationUz:
Uchala maqol ham VAQT va O'ZGARISH haqida —
butun 9-unitning mavzusi ('Times Change...').

Bularni so'zma-so'z tarjima qilib bo'lmaydi —
ma'nosini tushunish kerak.

sentences.en: Times change and we with time.
sentences.uz: Zamon o'zgaradi, biz ham u bilan birga.
sentences.noteUz:
MA'NOSI: dunyo o'zgargani kabi odamlar ham o'zgaradi.
Inishmore va Canary Wharf misollari shuni ko'rsatadi —
joy o'zgardi, u yerdagi hayot ham o'zgardi.

GRAMMATIKA: 'we with time' — 'we change with time' ning
qisqartirilgan shakli ('change' takrorlanmaydi).

O'ZBEKCHA MOSI: 'Zamona zayli' / 'Zamon bilan hamnafas bo'l'.

MA'NOSI: har bir davrning o'z qoidalari va odatlari bor.
Qadimgi Rimda bolalar hammomga kira olmasdi;
hozir bunday qoida yo'q. Bir davrda oddiy narsa
boshqa davrda g'alati ko'rinishi mumkin.

'manners' = odob, xulq-atvor, urf-odat.
DIQQAT: 'manners' bu ma'noda DOIM ko'plikda.

O'ZBEKCHA MOSI: 'Har zamonning o'z odati bor'.

sentences.en: Time and tide wait for no man.
sentences.uz: Vaqt va suv qaytishi hech kimni kutmaydi.
sentences.noteUz:
MA'NOSI: vaqt hech kim uchun to'xtamaydi —
imkoniyat kelganda darhol foydalanish kerak,
aks holda u o'tib ketadi.

'tide' = dengiz suvining ko'tarilib-qaytishi.
Dengizchilar suv qaytishini kutib turolmasdi —
vaqtida jo'nash kerak edi. Maqol shundan kelib chiqqan.

'wait FOR somebody' — 'for' shart.
'no man' = hech kim (eski uslubdagi ifoda).

O'ZBEKCHA MOSI: 'Vaqt hech kimni kutmaydi' /
'O'tgan kunni qaytarib bo'lmaydi'.

wordFormation.introUz: 67-bet — hozirgi ↔ o'tgan zamon jadvali, /s/-/ʃ/ tovushlari, shahar hududi lug'ati.

groups.ruleUz: MUCH va MANY — qaysi otga qaysi

patterns.formula: HOZIR: There is/are ... .   ILGARI: There was/were ... .
patterns.exampleEn: There is a bank opposite the cinema, but fifty years ago there wasn't a bank.
patterns.exampleUz: Kinoteatr ro'parasida bank bor, lekin ellik yil oldin bank yo'q edi.

patterns.formula: HOZIR: have/has got ... .   ILGARI: had ... / didn't have ... .
patterns.exampleEn: Now he has got three dogs, but he hasn't got any cats. When he was five, he had a cat.
patterns.exampleUz: Hozir uning uchta iti bor, lekin mushugi yo'q. Besh yoshida mushugi bor edi.
patterns.explanationUz: 'have got' ning o'tgan shakli — HAD (has got ham HAD).

patterns.formula: HOZIR: can + fe'l.   ILGARI: could + fe'l.
patterns.exampleEn: When I was five, I could ride a bicycle, but I couldn't ride a motor bike. Now I can ride it very well.
patterns.exampleUz: Besh yoshimda velosiped hayday olardim, lekin mototsikl hayday olmasdim. Hozir uni juda yaxshi haydayman.
patterns.explanationUz: 'can/could' dan KEYIN doim FE'L keladi; 'have got' dan keyin OT.

patterns.formula: There weren't MANY + sanaladigan.   People didn't have MUCH + sanalmaydigan.
patterns.exampleEn: There weren't many shops or people. People didn't have much money.
patterns.exampleUz: Ko'p do'kon yoki odam yo'q edi. Odamlarda ko'p pul yo'q edi.

patterns.formula: People could ONLY get around BY bus or ON foot.
patterns.exampleEn: People could only get around by bus or on foot.
patterns.exampleUz: Odamlar faqat avtobusda yoki piyoda yura olardi.
patterns.explanationUz:
'only' cheklovni bildiradi.
Transport — BY, lekin PIYODA — ON foot.

patterns.formula: This area is now completely different to what it was like twenty years ago.
patterns.exampleEn: This area is now completely different to what it was like twenty years ago.
patterns.exampleUz: Bu hudud yigirma yil oldingidan butunlay boshqacha.
patterns.explanationUz:
'then-and-now' maqolasining tayyor kirish qolipi.
'different to' (britancha) = 'different from'.
